scripts.android:old: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh old && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=old npx react-native run-android
scripts.android:new: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh new && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=new npx react-native run-android
scripts.android:bridgeless: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh bridgeless && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=bridgeless npx react-native run-android
scripts.ios:old: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh old && cd ios && xcodebuild clean -workspace SampleApp.xcworkspace -scheme SampleApp && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=old npx react-native run-ios --simulator='iPhone 17 Pro'
scripts.ios:new: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh new && cd ios && xcodebuild clean -workspace SampleApp.xcworkspace -scheme SampleApp && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=new npx react-native run-ios --simulator='iPhone 17 Pro'
scripts.ios:bridgeless: ./scripts/switch-architecture.sh bridgeless && cd ios && xcodebuild clean -workspace SampleApp.xcworkspace -scheme SampleApp && cd .. && REACT_NATIVE_ARCH=bridgeless npx react-native run-ios --simulator='iPhone 17 Pro'
